children: GE Aerospace says its planned acquisition of Consolidated Precision Products, announced last month, will allow the company to increase deliveries and accelerate the introduction of new engine technologies that improve cooling. It will also enhance the durability and efficiency of the company's current fleet and future programs, CEO Larry Culp says on a call with analysts. "Our agreement to acquire a long-term supplier is a significant investment to build adequate capacity of mission critical castings for the entire aerospace industry," he says. (connor.hart@wsj.com)
